check: pricing assignment completeness — the pre-deploy safety condition for the refusal
why: The change being deployed makes an absent pricing decision refuse at capture and at settlement. Between 'the engine refuses' and 'every owner is assigned' lies the one dangerous state this can produce: an engine that fails closed and owners with nothing assigned, which is an outage rather than a fix. This is the check that the dangerous state does not exist BEFORE the refusal ships.

assertions.observed: explicit 0-bps rule, not an absent one
Doa carries the generic sandbox-donation-200 profile, the same object any owner can be assigned

note: DOA being ASSIGNED the 200-bps profile is not the same claim as DOA having SETTLED at 200 bps. No post-cutover economic E2E has been run yet; that is a separate, still-outstanding proof.
